rules.description: Demo seed and simulation CLIs may use the demo profile contract.
The dev tools binary starts the seeder and the simulator. The dev-tools compose role has exactly one package, the dev tools binary cmd/devtools (ADR 0060).
The dev tools binary drives the server through its HTTP API. The dev-tools compose role has exactly one package, the dev tools binary cmd/devtools (ADR 0060).
The demo process opens its own phoenix_demo connection. The dev-tools compose role has exactly one package, the dev tools binary cmd/devtools (ADR 0060).
The demo process composes the demo school state and queue on its own connection. The dev-tools compose role has exactly one package, the dev tools binary cmd/devtools (ADR 0060).
The demo process composes the demo access expiry on its own connection. The dev-tools compose role has exactly one package, the dev tools binary cmd/devtools (ADR 0060).
The demo process composes the presence reads of its ticks on its own connection. The dev-tools compose role has exactly one package, the dev tools binary cmd/devtools (ADR 0060).
The demo process reads presence inside a tenant-scoped transaction. The dev-tools compose role has exactly one package, the dev tools binary cmd/devtools (ADR 0060).

The dev tools binary draws generated seed credentials from the cryptographic entropy Security Runtime owns (#3364). The dev-tools compose role has exactly one package, the dev tools binary cmd/devtools (ADR 0060).
